gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed solid tumor for which regorafenib is an approved treatment (e.g., metastatic colorectal cancer, gastrointestinal stromal tumor, hepatocellular carcinoma, glioblastoma, or others)

candidate_evidence.quote: whether a combination of oral zinc supplementation and transdermal clobetasol cream is effective in preventing and reducing the severity of hand-foot skin reaction (HFSR) induced by regorafenib treatment

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Initiating regorafenib treatment for the first time

role_evidence.quote: This intervention aims to assess the efficacy of clobetasol in preventing regorafenib-induced HFSR.
This intervention aims to evaluate the effect of zinc in preventing and reducing the severity of regorafenib-induced hand-foot skin reaction (HFSR).
Initiating regorafenib treatment for the first time

agents.drug_class_hint: multikinase inhibitor (background therapy, not a registered intervention)

coder_notes: Supportive-care trial for regorafenib-induced hand-foot skin reaction; no antitumour hypothesis for zinc or clobetasol. Regorafenib is background for all patients (not a registered intervention but received by every participant). Glioblastoma named only as one example in inclusion criteria, hence basket_gbm_eligible. All three arms are labelled EXPERIMENTAL and none works as a control.
